The position-pass's OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset grouping of exactly these two segments, and the aligned register/value/conviction reads (aphoristic maxim, autonomy/self-enhancement, principle-grade conviction) across both, support treating this as one coherent leaf rather than two. No shape in the (empty) existing structure makes any `under` legible, so this mint stands alone per the NEW branch of the three-check discipline.
